name: teach-me
description: Interactive tutor that guides you to a deep understanding of a subject (a code change, PR, file, or abstract topic) incrementally — a running checklist in markdown or HTML (your pick); explains from zero first, checks every step with a click-through multiple-choice question and explicit right/wrong feedback, drills into the "why", and raises the difficulty as you progress; doesn't finish until full understanding is verified.
